work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief CXCIX restores the college of Fermo with its church to the Society of Jesus, regulates the seminary’s payments and the Collegio Marziale, and exempts the college from the archbishop; across own provenance LF43059, page numbers LF43062, LF43268 (OCR 2995), LF43334 and running titles LF43128, LF43265, LF43400; complete 5 March 1839 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF43041–43041; the source closing at LF43457–43460 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die quinta martii millesimo octin- gentesimo trigesimo nono, pontificatus Nostri anno nono. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
